newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Prestasi launches new insurance product.
newsitem.headline: Prestasi launches new insurance product.

text.p: South Africa's Prestasi Financial Services Ltd on Wednesday announced the launch of an investment-based short term insurance contract which it said was the first of its kind in the country.
Prestasi said in a statement that the product, called Invesure, was a combination of a personal short insurance policy and a commission free, low cost mutual fund, the Prestasi SA Tracker Unit Trust.

"The Invesure concept has been actuarially designed to facilitate the subsidisation of the major part of the insurance excess and premiums by the anticipated growth in the unit trust portion of the investment," the firm said.
The product aims to reduce insurance premiums to a minimum level, whilst at the same time providing individuals with a growing investment.
Prestasi said that its SA Tracker fund, which commenced business on January 2, 1997, had reported a return of 16.25 percent for the six months ending June 30.

The fund, which tracks the Johannesburg Stock Exchange all share index, is managed by Coronation Asset Management. It holds no direct holdings in gold shares but has a 50 percent exposure to other mining stocks.
